limitation.result: PNG input is rejected ('docs/... is an image (image/png); reading images is not supported'), so the screenshots could not be inspected as images by the model. This record is a coarse, machine-derived review only; it cannot establish that text is correct or legible.
limitation.mitigation: Every label and money value is corroborated by the rendered DOM text and the API payloads captured in the same headless-Chrome session (docs/evidence/browser-qa-production-20261012T2313Z.json) and by the read-only production probe (24/24 checks, docs/evidence/production-probe-20261012T2312Z.json).

checks.firstViewportValues: PASS mobile: item subtotal, shipping charge and method are visible in the initial viewport; PASS mobile: the delivered total is visible in the initial 390x844 viewport (best card top 302, totals bottom 591)
checks.homeIndex: PASS mobile home: the product card is visible on the first screen; the home route renders the product index, not the comparison board
checks.unifiedComparison: PASS compare: the Coffee4U listing with unstated blend wording is in the same comparison, not withheld; PASS compare: no variant-exclusion notice or blend wording is repeated
checks.namedVendors: PASS pickup: every pickup row names the real vendor, not an object string
checks.methodAndCertainty: PASS product: the three decision values sit in one visible row; named delivery method rendered separately from the certainty label
checks.policyStatus: PASS status exposes every validated shipping policy with a review date; PASS no shipping policy is past its review date (production probe, 24/24 checks)

conclusion: The deployed four-policy build keeps the decision values (item subtotal, named method and charge, delivered total) inside the initial 390x844 mobile viewport; the home index stays minimal (a single blue rule, no offer status colors) and the product page uses the Canton Zürich token roles (blue for the best/selected context, green for in-stock, amber for uncertainty, no red on the live board). No claim of image-based visual review is made.
